name: Sarcolestes
isnote: Known only from a partial mandible; one of few Middle Jurassic ankylosaurians (cited Wikipedia revision); position inside Ankylosauria not resolved.
sum: Sarcolestes is an early ankylosaur from the Middle Jurassic Oxford Clay of England, known only from a partial lower jaw.
holotype: NHMUK PV R 2682, a partial left mandible and fused scute damaged during excavation — Oxford Clay Formation, England.
author: Lydekker 1893
